explication: XNNPACK is a low-level neural-network inference library that supplies optimized operators to higher-level frameworks. A typical graph-based workflow defines tensor values and operator nodes, builds a runtime, then reshapes, sets up, and executes the selected operators to produce output tensors. The repository also contains direct operator APIs, architecture-specific kernels, weight packing, and a LiteRT tensor backend. The README documents broad operator and architecture coverage; sampled code verifies the average-pooling path, while several wider runtime links remain unverified.
